login.introEyebrow: A space for your next idea
login.introBody: A shared studio for images, creative direction, and the people behind them.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the account created by your organization owner.
login.invalidCredentials: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your username and password and try again.
login.unavailable: Your workspace could not respond yet. It may be starting after being idle. Wait a moment and try again.
login.waiting: Signing in. The first request after being idle can take a little longer.

profile.changeHelp: Choose a password with at least 10 characters. You will sign in again on every device after changing it.
profile.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
profile.invalidNew: Use a new password with 10 to 256 characters.
profile.changeFailed: Your password could not be changed. Please try again.

team.title: The people in your studio
team.intro: Create accounts for your team. Everyone has a personal image library and can share selected files or folders with others in your organization.
team.balanceHelp: This sets available credit. Confirmed charges reduce credit. Final costs can exceed remaining credit; add credit before another generation. Outstanding estimates are shown separately.
team.balanceInvalid: Use a nonnegative USD amount with up to twelve decimal places.
team.saveFailed: The account could not be saved. Please try again.
team.invalidUsername: Use up to 64 characters, starting with a letter or number. Letters, numbers, dots, underscores, dashes, plus signs and {'@'} are allowed.
team.invalidDisplayName: Enter a display name of up to 80 characters.
team.invalidPassword: Use a password with 10 to 256 characters.
team.editHelp: Disabling an account revokes its sessions. Resetting a password signs the user out on all devices.
team.createHelp: Give the person their username and password privately. They can change their password after signing in.
team.roleHelp: Organization owners can create and manage accounts. A role does not give access to another person’s private files.

balance.title: Your generation balance
balance.totalPaidHelp: Payments recorded by organization owners · USD
balance.unpaidHelp: Confirmed spend minus received payments · USD
balance.note: Outstanding amounts are estimates and are separate from unpaid bills. Payments settle confirmed bills without changing generation credit. Images are released once the final Gateway price is confirmed. New accounts have unlimited credit unless an organization owner sets a balance.
balance.loadFailed: Could not load your balance. Try again.

payments.title: Payment history
payments.subtitle: Payments received against confirmed bills · USD
payments.recordHelp: This records money already received. It settles bills without changing generation credit or the original charges.
payments.finiteInfo: New payment entries are available for users with Unlimited credit. This account’s existing payment history stays visible.
payments.emptyOwner: Record a received payment to keep track of paid bills.
payments.emptyMember: Payments recorded by your organization owner will appear here.
payments.footnote: Only organization owners can add payment entries. Payment history is read-only.
payments.loadFailed: Could not load payment history. Try again.
payments.loadMoreFailed: Could not load more payments. Try again.
payments.duplicate: Payment already recorded. No duplicate was added.
payments.notUnlimited: This account no longer has Unlimited credit. Refresh its balance before recording a payment.
payments.forbidden: Only an organization owner can record payments for users in this organization.
payments.rejected: The payment was not recorded. Check the amount and account, then try again.
payments.uncertain: We could not confirm whether this payment was recorded. Retry the same payment to check safely.
payments.invalidAmount: Enter an amount between $0.01 and $1,000,000 with at most two decimal places.
payments.invalidNote: Use a note of up to 500 characters without control characters.

credit.title: More balance needed
credit.usedUp: Your available generation credit is used up.
credit.ownerHint: Add credit from Team before starting another generation.
credit.memberHint: Ask your organization owner to add credit before starting another generation.
credit.exhausted: Your available credit is exhausted. Ask your organization owner to update your balance.
credit.outstanding: Your previous prices are still being confirmed. Wait for them to settle before another generation can use your credit.
credit.unavailable: Could not confirm your available credit. Try again before generating.

rerun.notCompleted: Only completed jobs can be rerun. Use Retry failed steps for failed or interrupted work.
rerun.cancelling: Wait for the remaining cancelled work to finish before rerunning a job.
rerun.pricesPending: Wait for this job’s exact prices to be confirmed before rerunning it.
rerun.attemptLimit: This job has reached its five-attempt limit. Start a new run for more variants.

session.expired: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.

recovery.warmupBody: The first request after being idle can take longer while the app and database start. Your session is preserved. Wait a moment, then try again.
recovery.failedBody: Please try loading your workspace again.
